discription: A simple bell-like sound using two slightly detuned sine waves with a percussive decay envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.005, decay=1.5; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.perc(attack, decay, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = (SinOsc.ar(freq) + SinOsc.ar(freq * 1.007)) * 0.5; sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
